cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I went outside when you did. If you're my friend, give me your place in the queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only went to collect my bag. The usher kept my place; you left altogether.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, coming back in order. Let me stand where you were.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's one ticket left. If I give you my place, I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then miss it for me. I wouldn't ask that of just anyone.

reason: Remove the unprepared prior promise. Use the already stated friendship and explicit admission loss to make a direct personal sacrifice request.
